matches.rationale: Finding 1 directly identifies the ambiguous residual-label masking formulation and demonstrates that it can produce negative labels for permitted values of lambda and prior predictions. Finding 3 identifies the unaccounted shared-encoder assumption: the paper's analysis treats modality parameters as independent despite shared encoder/head parameters, matching the ground-truth concern about inconsistent objectives and unsupported shared-parameter assumptions.

pred_verdicts.rationale: It specifically detects the residual-label masking and lambda formulation defect described in the ground truth.
It raises a concrete issue in the adaptive classifier-assignment guards, which is not the sustained-boosting defect in the ground truth.
It identifies the contradiction between shared parameters and an analysis assuming independent modality parameters.
It identifies a separate normalization issue in the appendix confidence-score statistic.
It identifies a separate missing step-size condition in the appendix convergence argument.
It identifies a separate missing positivity side condition in the appendix reciprocal inequality.
